title: Jumlah Korban Terdampak Akibat Bencana Menurut Kabupaten 2024

title: Rekapitulasi Nilai Kerusakan dan Kerugian Berdasarkan Proposal RRRP
measure_scope: reported damage and loss from rehabilitation reconstruction proposals
notes: Proposal-derived administrative records are not assumed complete for all events

title: Peta Curah Hujan dan hari Hujan
measure_scope: rainfall and rainy-day map service
notes: Hosted-runner probe confirms REST and standard WMS access; layers are Peta Hari Hujan and Peta Curah Hujan but ArcGIS timeInfo and WMS TIME dimensions are absent, so this service is not a reproducible historical panel without separate vintage metadata

title: Data Prakiraan Cuaca Terbuka BMKG
measure_scope: prospective weather forecast including temperature humidity wind cloud visibility and weather state
notes: Forecast updates twice daily at three-hour steps; preserve analysis_date and never use forecast values as historical observed climate

title: Data Peringatan Dini Cuaca Terbuka BMKG
measure_scope: active weather warnings with CAP effective expiry and hazard areas
notes: Active feed is not a historical event archive unless Ranah Observatory snapshots immutable alert documents and handles updates cancellations duplicates and expiry semantics

title: Data Gempabumi Terbuka BMKG
measure_scope: latest earthquake and rolling recent M5+ or felt earthquake lists
notes: Open page exposes latest and rolling recent lists rather than a complete historical event archive

title: Data Online climate observations
measure_scope: daily climate observations including rainfall RR
notes: Preferred station-observation candidate; acquisition constraints must remain explicit
